newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha tracks sideways, buying still thin.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha tracks sideways, buying still thin.

text.p: NWE naphtha moved sideways on Friday alongside listless crude, traders said. December swaps stayed between $223 and $224.75 cif NWE.
Skikda remains closed, supporting the market, with at least four large cargoes now delayed there.

U.S. arbitrage outlets remain theoretically interesting but the Thanksgiving holiday has stifled trade. End-user demand remains thin as relaxed dealers, eyeing the $10 December/January backwardation, said they could wait to buy product.
